papers.abstract: In sampled cascade linear active disturbance rejection control (LADRC) of quadrotors, the extended-state observer typically receives the instantaneous command, although the delayed measurement reflects an earlier, rotor-filtered acceleration. This paper proposes actuator-aware (AA) observer inputs: altitude and attitude observers use limited virtual inputs filtered by an assumed rotor model and aligned with the measurement delay, and horizontal observers use acceleration reconstructed from measured attitude. Fixed gains are selected on the discrete-time model under sensitivity and step-response requirements and stationary covariance ceilings on each channel's control variance and increment and on the noise-induced inner-loop increment of the full cascade. In paired set-point trials, PID-Budget, AA-Budget and AA-HalfGain reach mean RMSEs of 65.5, 19.2 and 16.9~mm; under a stricter common cascade ceiling, the AA designs reach 29.9 and 26.4~mm versus 72.3~mm for a PID that uses roughly double their rotor-command increment. PX4 software-in-the-loop runs reproduce these results. Behind EKF2, a noise model fitted to the estimation errors predicts the roll/pitch and yaw increments within 5\% on held-out and out-of-sample runs and the total rotor-command increment within 14\%. Redesigned for this stack under the same sensitivity and response specification and estimator-aware ceilings, AA-Budget-E reduces the set-point RMSE from 59.1~mm (PID-E) to 44.0~mm with a lower rotor-command increment in every paired set-point and lemniscate run (mean S6 rotor-command-increment reductions relative to PID-E: 45\% before and 15\% after output quantization); AA-HalfGain-E beats PID-E only on the lemniscate. The evidence is simulation-based, and the ceilings are nominal tuning constraints.

analysis.key_results: 在成对设定点试验中，PID-Budget、AA-Budget与AA-HalfGain的平均RMSE分别为65.5、19.2和16.9 mm；在更严格的共同级联协方差上限下，AA设计的RMSE为29.9和26.4 mm，而PID为72.3 mm，且PID的旋翼指令增量约为AA的两倍。PX4软件在环仿真复现了这些结果。针对EKF2状态估计误差拟合的噪声模型在留出与样本外数据上预测滚转/俯仰与偏航增量误差在5%以内，总旋翼指令增量误差在14%以内。针对该软件栈重新设计的AA-Budget-E将设定点RMSE从PID-E的59.1 mm降至44.0 mm，并在所有成对设定点与双纽线轨迹中实现更低的旋翼指令增量（输出量化前相对PID-E平均减少45%，量化后减少15%）；AA-HalfGain-E仅在双纽线轨迹上优于PID-E。
analysis.limitations: 证据均基于仿真，协方差上限仅为标称调参约束。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出执行器感知（AA）的观测器输入：高度与姿态观测器使用经旋翼模型滤波并与测量延迟对齐的受限虚拟输入，水平观测器使用由测量姿态重构的加速度；并给出考虑灵敏度、阶跃响应及协方差上限的离散时间增益选择方法。
analysis.method: 在离散时间模型上设计固定增益，以灵敏度与阶跃响应要求以及各级控制方差和增量、噪声引起的级联内环增量的稳态协方差上限为约束；采用执行器感知的观测器输入信号构造。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 针对四旋翼级联LADRC中观测器输入与延迟测量失配的问题，提出执行器感知的观测器输入设计，并通过仿真验证其轨迹跟踪性能与噪声抑制效果。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作聚焦于四旋翼无人机级联ADRC的观测器输入设计与增益整定，并考虑输出量化对控制性能的影响，属于机器人控制与模型量化交叉领域。但未涉及VLA（视觉-语言-动作）或WAM（世界-动作模型），与本站关注的机器人学习、操作等主题无直接关联；其量化分析仅针对执行器输出量化，与LLM/VLA推理中的模型量化不同。

papers.abstract: Learning from offline datasets is limited in scalability, as collecting new experience is often costly or unsafe in the real world. World models offer an alternative way to generate new experience through a learned dynamics model, yet learning policies in latent space is limited due to compounding errors in imagined rollouts. To this end, we propose using the world model as a local transition generator, leveraging critic guidance to choose actions inside that model to generate synthetic experiences. We study action refinement methodologies, introducing Critic-Guided Synthetic Experience (CGSE) generation in world models. Specifically, CGSE augments an existing offline dataset by sampling candidate actions using an offline policy and refining each to maximize a first-order approximation of the $Q$-function within a trust region. We then use a frozen latent world model to imagine the future state given each updated action, and use the critic to choose the best one, appending this synthetic transition to the replay buffer. Our method requires no additional real-environment interaction or test-time planner, as it generates synthetic experience offline using the world model. On three OGBench manipulation tasks, CGSE improves an offline policy by a relative improvement of $7.1\%$ on the average success rate.

analysis.key_results: 在三个OGBench操作任务上，CGSE将离线策略的平均成功率相对提高了7.1%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Critic-Guided Synthetic Experience (CGSE)方法，通过冻结的潜在世界模型和评论家引导生成合成经验，无需额外真实环境交互或测试时规划，即可提升离线策略性能。
analysis.method: 使用离线策略采样候选动作，通过信任域内的一阶Q函数近似优化动作，再利用冻结的潜在世界模型想象未来状态，并由评论家选择最佳合成转移加入回放缓冲。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出CGSE方法，利用潜在世界模型和评论家引导生成合成经验，以增强离线数据集并改进机器人操作策略。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该研究直接涉及机器人操作策略学习和世界模型（WAM），通过世界模型生成合成经验增强离线数据，提升机器人操作任务的成功率，与本站主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Collecting naturalistic human manipulation demonstrations with accurate contact force and hand pose is essential for robot dexterous manipulation policy and foundational world model learning - yet no existing wearable platform provides both calibrated fingertip force sensing and occlusion-resilient hand tracking in a form factor that preserves natural manipulation behavior. We present Tactus, a textile-integrated sensing glove that co-optimizes three design pillars: (1) a thin, conformal 3D-knit form factor (1.5 mm fingertip stackup) designed to minimize interference with natural manipulation, (2) strategically placed capacitive tactile sensors at manipulation-relevant regions informed by empirical contact studies, and (3) IMU-fused pose tracking that maintains accuracy through the hand-object occlusions where manipulation data is most valuable. Tactus includes a documented calibration pipeline for cross-glove consistency and per-session calibration for subject-dependent correction. To enable objective comparison, we introduce standardized benchmarking protocols for tactile force regression and hand pose estimation, and apply them to Tactus and two commercially available tactile gloves - to our knowledge the first quantitative cross-platform evaluation of this kind. Tactus resolves a minimum detectable force of 0.59 N at 95% confidence, 1.6 - 2.7x lower than the commercial baselines, and with 0.87 cross-participant consistency, while our pose tracking sustains 11.0 mm fingertip keypoint relative error during manipulation, when occlusion is heaviest. We show that these combined signals support object property estimation, slip detection, and representative recording of hand-object interaction - yielding demonstration data with the fidelity required for contact-aware manipulation policies and world models.

analysis.key_results: 最小可检测力0.59N（95%置信度），比商业基线低1.6-2.7倍；跨参与者一致性0.87；操作中指尖关键点相对误差11.0mm。
analysis.main_contribution: 开发了Tactus手套，集成了3D针织外形、操纵相关区域的电容触觉传感和IMU融合位姿跟踪，并建立了标准化基准协议进行跨平台评估。
analysis.method: 3D针织共形设计、基于经验接触研究的电容触觉传感器布置、IMU融合位姿跟踪、标定管道及标准化基准测试。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种集成触觉与位姿传感的纺织手套Tactus，用于自然灵巧操作演示数据的采集与基准评测。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作为接触感知操作策略和世界模型提供高保真数据采集平台，但不直接涉及VLA或WAM模型本身，而是通过数据采集硬件支持相关学习任务。

papers.abstract: Anticipating the motion of nearby objects is critical for safe and efficient robot navigation. Without a proper understanding of what may move, a robot may plan overly conservative, inefficient trajectories to guarantee safety, or it may be overly risky, resulting in unacceptable collisions. While tracking and predicting the motion of known objects has seen significant progress, little research addresses how a robot should adapt online to novel objects, including anticipating how one object may move another (e.g., a person operating a forklift to move a pallet). To enable this capability, we propose a meta-learned graph neural network that leverages a semantic, geometric, and relational history of objects to accurately predict, from a few online observations, when objects will begin to move in new environments. We demonstrate that our method, which is trained only in simulation, accurately anticipates the motion of objects unseen at training time, transfers to hardware without any fine-tuning, and outperforms a vision-language model and a class-frequency baseline in both simulation and hardware experiments. Our method's accurate prediction enables collision-free traversals in a closed-loop navigation simulation, while remaining within four seconds of the fastest, collision-prone planner.

analysis.key_results: 在仿真和硬件实验中，该方法能准确预测未见物体的运动，优于视觉语言模型和类别频率基线；在闭环导航仿真中实现无碰撞通过，且与最快但易碰撞规划器相比仅慢四秒。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种元学习的图神经网络，利用物体的语义、几何和关系历史，在少量在线观测下预测新环境中物体何时开始移动。
analysis.method: 元学习图神经网络，仅使用仿真训练，融合语义、几何和关系历史。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出一种元学习图神经网络，利用物体语义、几何和关系历史，在少量在线观测下预测新环境中物体何时开始移动，以支持安全高效的机器人导航。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作涉及开放世界物体运动预测，属于世界建模范畴，对机器人导航中的动态环境理解有直接价值，但未明确针对VLA或WAM架构。

papers.abstract: Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates autoregressive inference by leveraging the memory bound nature of decoding, verifying multiple draft tokens in a single forward pass. For mixture-of-experts (MoE) models, prior work predicts a concave speedup-batch size relationship, with gains peaking at intermediate batch sizes due to expert saturation. We evaluate this across 10 sparse MoE models (30B--1T parameters, 8--512 experts) and find recent fine-grained models break this trend, showing higher speedup at low batch size. We find verification cost is governed not only by activated-expert bytes, but also by temporal overlap across draft tokens and GPU execution dynamics. At low batch size, MoE layers in fine-grained models account for a much smaller share of runtime than of weights; on H100, kernel profiling attributes this mainly to higher bandwidth utilization of MoE kernels relative to attention, with L2 absorbing repeated reads of co-routed experts. Across draft tokens, routing overlap further reduces the unique experts activated during verification relative to independence assumptions. We model this effect using a maximum-entropy Iterative Proportional Fitting (IPF) framework that predicts unique expert counts from routing-overlap statistics with less than 4\% error, and substantially narrows the gap to real-model curves and captures the qualitative low-batch trend from synthetic routing.

analysis.key_results: 细粒度模型在低批大小下表现出更高的加速；验证成本不仅由激活专家字节决定，还受草稿令牌跨时间重叠和GPU执行动态影响；IPF模型预测唯一专家数量的误差小于4%。
analysis.main_contribution: 揭示了细粒度稀疏专家混合模型在推测解码中打破先前预测的凹形加速-批大小关系，并提出了基于最大熵迭代比例拟合的模型来预测唯一专家数量。
analysis.method: 对10个稀疏专家混合模型（30B--1T参数，8--512专家）进行实验评估，并通过GPU内核分析和最大熵迭代比例拟合（IPF）框架进行建模。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文研究了推测解码在稀疏专家混合模型上的实际加速效果，并发现细粒度模型在低批大小下优于先前预测，同时揭示了验证成本的关键影响因素。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文关注一般的大语言模型推测解码效率，未直接涉及VLA或WAM，但可能对VLA模型的稀疏化推理加速具有参考价值。

papers.abstract: Speculative decoding speeds up large language model (LLM) serving only while the GPU has spare compute, so the best draft length, the number of tokens a small drafter guesses per step, shrinks as the batch grows. vLLM lets operators set the draft length for each batch size with a hand-written table, but nothing measures or corrects that table. We present TableTune. Its tuner times the decoding step for every batch size and draft length on vLLM's own serving path and computes, in minutes, the table that maximizes throughput. Its controller, a vLLM plugin, tracks how many guesses are accepted in live traffic and rebuilds the table while serving. We measure TableTune only against other ways to speculate. On an H100, the tuned table delivers at least 94% of the throughput of the best fixed draft length at every load in four of five drafter settings (88% in the fifth) without the operator having to know which length that is. Against reimplementations of TurboSpec- and Nightjar-style control on the same engine, its worst-case loss is never higher than theirs, and with the EAGLE-3 drafter it is 3% against 9% and 12%. On a mixture-of-experts model, vLLM's documented table loses up to 18% and the tuned table at most 3%. Starting from mistuned tables, the controller raises throughput by up to 58% (up to 45% on vLLM's default runner), and after a workload switch with the DFlash drafter it recovers 96% of a stale table's loss. In llm-d's optimized-baseline deployment as shipped, two Qwen3-32B replicas on four GPUs, the tuned table is up to 32% faster than a fixed draft length of 3 and up to 25% faster than vLLM's documented table at high load, and the controller raises the documented table's throughput by up to 29%.

analysis.key_results: 在 H100 上，调优表在五种中的四种草稿设置中，各负载下吞吐达到最佳固定草稿长度的至少 94%（第五种为 88%）；相比 TurboSpec 和 Nightjar 风格控制，最坏损失不高于它们，使用 EAGLE-3 草稿时为 3% 对 9% 和 12%；在混合专家模型上，vLLM 文档表损失高达 18%，调优表最多 3%；从错误表开始，控制器最高提升吞吐 58%（vLLM 默认运行器最高 45%）；在 llm-d 部署中，调优表比固定长度 3 快至多 32%，比 vLLM 文档表快至多 25%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 TableTune 系统，包含离线调优器和在线控制器，可自动生成并动态调整 vLLM 推测解码在不同批大小下的草稿长度表，避免手动调参。
analysis.method: 调优器在 vLLM 服务路径上测量不同批大小和草稿长度的解码步耗时，几分钟内计算出最大化吞吐的表；控制器作为 vLLM 插件跟踪接受率并实时重建表。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: TableTune 通过离线实测和在线自适应控制器，为 vLLM 动态推测解码自动生成并维护最佳草稿长度表，从而提高吞吐量。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于推测解码的独立效率优化，不直接涉及 VLA 或 WAM。但其动态批处理场景下的草稿长度自适应方法，可能对部署在机器人服务器上的 VLA 模型推理加速具有潜在参考价值。

papers.abstract: Predictive world-model objectives need not organize latent histories according to distinctions required for later control. With privileged simulator access during training, should response-derived structural information be predicted, decoded, or imposed directly on latent geometry--and how do these choices compare with structured belief distillation? We define posterior-marginalized structural tests whose response distributions induce a pseudometric over histories, then train quotient-preserving (QP) world models by aligning shared latent Euclidean distances to that metric. Across a fixed six-task diagnostic suite, the largest differences appear under held-out structural variation: QP improves planning success by 26.1 points $[21.5,30.7]$ over metric decoding and 6.4 points $[3.8,9.0]$ over structured belief distillation. On GridWorld, metric decoding accurately recovers held-out structural distances ($\rho=.91$) while its native latent geometry remains more distorted than QP's (paired IQD difference $.22$ $[.20,.24]$), showing that relational recoverability and direct geometric alignment can diverge.

analysis.key_results: 在六任务套件上，QP比度量解码提升规划成功率26.1个百分点，比结构化信念蒸馏提升6.4个百分点；在GridWorld上，度量解码能恢复结构距离（ρ=.91），但其原生潜在几何仍比QP更失真（IQD差0.22）。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出保商（QP）世界模型，通过将共享潜在欧氏距离与由响应分布诱导的伪度量对齐，直接对潜在几何施加结构信息，相比度量解码和结构化信念蒸馏能更好地保留对控制有用的结构。
analysis.method: 训练保商世界模型，对齐潜在空间距离与结构测试定义的伪度量；在六任务诊断套件和GridWorld上比较QP、度量解码和结构化信念蒸馏。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文研究在具有模拟器特权访问的情况下，如何通过结构测试诱导的伪度量来对齐世界模型的潜在几何，从而提升部分可观测环境中的规划性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文聚焦于世界模型中的潜在几何对齐和部分可观测规划，属于世界建模方法研究，但未直接涉及视觉-语言-动作（VLA）或机器人操作任务，与VLA/WAM无直接关系。

papers.abstract: Looped Transformers increase computational capacity through the repeated application of shared blocks, but their recurrent depth makes conventional full-depth decoding expensive. While existing speculative pipelines accelerate generation by processing consecutive token positions at varying depths, they are typically limited by sequential decoding overheads. We introduce CopyLoop, a training-free decoding algorithm that combines low-cost context-copy proposals with shallow screening and continuous recurrent scheduling. Rather than step-by-step generation, CopyLoop proposes multi-token suffixes from repeated context. It then evaluates them early at a shallow recurrent depth to efficiently filter out incorrect branches, processing newer blocks concurrently while earlier blocks are still progressing toward full-depth verification. We evaluate CopyLoop across six model checkpoints from the Ouro, Raven, and Huginn families, covering code generation and multi-step mathematical reasoning. CopyLoop achieves decoding speedups of 2.98x--10.70x over full-depth autoregressive decoding on Base models and 2.74x--3.52x on Thinking models, consistently outperforming or closely matching all competing baselines across evaluation tasks. Furthermore, ablation studies confirm a strong synergy between shallow screening and continuous scheduling, while our analyses show that CopyLoop requires only lightweight model calibration and yields greater speedups on longer generations with reusable contexts.

analysis.key_results: 在Ouro、Raven和Huginn三个模型家族的六个检查点上，CopyLoop相比于全深度自回归解码在Base模型上实现了2.98x到10.70x的加速，在Thinking模型上实现了2.74x到3.52x的加速，且在所有评估任务上持续优于或匹配所有竞争基线。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出CopyLoop，一种免训练的循环Transformer解码算法，将低成本的上下文复制提议与浅层筛选和连续循环调度相结合，实现高效的多token后缀提议与早期错误分支过滤。
analysis.method: CopyLoop使用上下文复制生成多token后缀提议，在浅层循环深度进行早期筛选，并采用连续循环调度，使较新块与较旧块并行处理。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: CopyLoop是一种免训练的解码算法，通过上下文复制提议、浅层筛选和连续循环调度，显著加速循环Transformer的生成。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于循环Transformer的高效解码，与VLA、WAM或机器人动作世界模型没有直接关系，但其推测解码技术可能对高效部署大型机器人策略模型有潜在参考价值。

papers.title: CopyLoop: Fast Looped Transformer Decoding via Context Copying and Shallow Screening
papers.title_zh: CopyLoop：通过上下文复制与浅层筛选加速循环Transformer解码

papers.abstract: We run Kroko, a 65.7M-parameter streaming Zipformer2 transducer for English, on the ESP32-P4, a microcontroller with two 400 MHz RISC-V cores, a 128-bit SIMD extension (PIE) and 32 MB of PSRAM, but no neural accelerator. Without any training, the encoder's 290 matrices are stored with 2 or 4 bits per weight in Hadamard-rotated groups: the width of each matrix comes from its measured sensitivity, and each matrix is first corrected toward the original model's output, then rounded with GPTQ and a search over the group norms. The released 71 MB of int8 weights become a 26.65 MB file. Activations are int16 between the matrix products and int8 into them. A C engine with hand-written PIE kernels processes each 1.28 s chunk of audio in 0.90 s on both cores, beam search included, and its PC build computes the same bits as the chip, so accuracy is measured on whole test sets. LibriSpeech WER is 4.34% on test-clean and 10.26% on test-other, against 3.94% and 9.17% for the released model; on FLEURS and Common Voice the gap grows to 2.3 and 1.1 points. A GPU simulator shows that the integer arithmetic costs nothing and that the whole gap comes from the weights, and an ablation on all of test-clean shows that GPTQ does most of the work. We also report the port's speed history, from 51.3 s to 0.62 s of encoder time per chunk, each design step measured again in one build, an attempt to reach 16 MB that stopped at 19.63 MB, and what did not work. We did not measure energy. The inference engine, the firmware and the 2/4-bit weights are available at https://github.com/BoumedineBillal/esp32-pie-asr.

analysis.key_results: LibriSpeech WER：test-clean 4.34%（原始3.94%），test-other 10.26%（原始9.17%）；FLEURS和Common Voice上差距增大至2.3和1.1个百分点。每个1.28秒音频块在双核上处理耗时0.90秒。量化后模型大小26.65MB，内存占用降低。GPU模拟表明整数运算无损失，差距全部来自权重；消融实验表明GPTQ贡献最大。
analysis.limitations: 未测量能耗；量化后与原始模型在部分数据集上准确率差距增大；试图压缩至16MB但停在19.63MB。
analysis.main_contribution: 实现在无神经网络加速器的ESP32-P4上，以32MB PSRAM的极其有限内存运行65.7M参数的流式ASR模型，并通过定制量化管线将模型压缩至26.65MB，同时保持与原始模型接近的准确率。
analysis.method: 灵敏度引导的Hadamard旋转分组；对每个矩阵先进行输出校正，再用GPTQ和组范数搜索进行2/4位量化；激活使用int16/int8；手写PIE SIMD内核的C推理引擎。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 在ESP32-P4微控制器上运行一个65.7M参数的流式语音识别模型，通过灵敏度引导的Hadamard旋转分组、GPTQ和组范数搜索，将权重压缩为2/4位并部署。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作专注于模型量化与高效推理，未涉及VLA（Visual-Language-Action）或WAM（World Action Model）。但其量化方法（灵敏度引导、GPTQ、Hadamard旋转）和极端资源约束下的部署经验，可迁移至机器人嵌入式端的模型压缩与边缘部署，对本站模型量化主题有参考价值。

papers.abstract: Self-distillation offers a way to improve reasoning models when a suitable external teacher is unavailable. However, common approaches rely on privileged information to construct a stronger self-teacher, limiting their use when only unlabeled prompts are available. In this paper, we introduce Weakening-Induced On-Policy Self-Distillation (WISD), which instead constructs a weaker counterpart of the original model and uses the contrast between the two as a training signal without requiring privileged information. We explore two ways to construct the weaker model: low-bit quantization and magnitude pruning. We evaluate WISD across diverse architectures and scales on mathematical and coding reasoning tasks. Across these benchmarks, quantization and pruning improve average accuracy over the original models by 4.0 and 5.5 percentage points, respectively, achieving state-of-the-art performance even without privileged information. Notably, pruning raises Qwen3.5-4B's accuracy from 57.7% to 70.5% on HMMT 2025 and from 39.1% to 56.7% on LiveCodeBench v6. Quantization raises Qwen3.6-35B-A3B's accuracy from 68.5% to 74.6% and from 61.8% to 69.5% on the same benchmarks, respectively. These results establish WISD as a novel and effective self-distillation framework for large reasoning models.

analysis.key_results: 量化和剪枝分别使平均精度提升4.0和5.5个百分点；剪枝使Qwen3.5-4B在HMMT 2025上从57.7%提升到70.5%，在LiveCodeBench v6上从39.1%提升到56.7%；量化使Qwen3.6-35B-A3B在相同基准上分别从68.5%提升到74.6%和从61.8%提升到69.5%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出弱化诱导在线自蒸馏（WISD），仅使用无标签提示，通过弱化原模型获得的对比信号进行自蒸馏，无需特权信息。
analysis.method: 构建弱化模型（低比特量化和幅度剪枝），利用弱化模型与原模型的输出对比作为训练信号进行在线自蒸馏。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出WISD自蒸馏框架，通过构建弱化模型（低比特量化或剪枝）并与原模型对比，无需外部教师即可提升推理模型精度。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于大型推理模型的自蒸馏，未涉及VLA（视觉-语言-动作）或WAM（世界-动作模型），但与模型量化相关，对高效推理有直接价值。

papers.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) reduces the memory footprint of vision-language-action (VLA) models, but lowering bit widths while maintaining task performance remains challenging. Existing work has used sensitivity estimates from calibration data to assign bit widths to different model components. However, using task success directly to guide mixed-precision allocation is underexplored because closed-loop evaluations are costly and the effect of quantizing one component depends on the precision of other components. To this end, we propose \textbf{QbD-VLA}, a task-guided mixed-precision quantization method that uses task success from short closed-loop evaluations to assign weight and activation bit widths while accounting for interactions between model components. Experiments covering four VLA models and all four LIBERO suites show strong task performance at average precisions of approximately 4 bits for weights and fewer than 6 bits for activations. On SIMPLER, the gain over uniform quantization is small. On a Franka Research 3 robot arm, simulation-selected allocations show no detected success-rate loss on X-VLA but fail on $\pi_{0.5}$. These findings support using task success to guide mixed-precision VLA quantization, while highlighting the need for real-world evaluation before deployment. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/jiuyixu25/QbD-VLA}{\texttt{github.com/jiuyixu25/QbD-VLA}}.

analysis.key_results: 在四个VLA模型和所有四个LIBERO套件上，平均权重精度约4比特、激活精度低于6比特时仍保持强劲任务性能；在SIMPLER上，相比均匀量化增益较小；在Franka Research 3机械臂上，模拟选择的分配在X-VLA上未检测到成功率损失，但在π0.5上失败。
analysis.limitations: 真实世界评估增益有限，仿真选择的量化配置未能泛化到所有模型（π0.5失败），需要部署前真实世界评估。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出QbD-VLA，一种任务引导的混合精度量化方法，利用闭环评估的任务成功率来分配权重和激活的比特位宽，并考虑模型组件间的相互作用。
analysis.method: 使用短闭环评估的任务成功率来引导混合精度量化，同时考虑模型组件间的交互，分配权重和激活的比特位宽。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出QbD-VLA，一种利用任务成功率来指导视觉-语言-动作模型混合精度量化的方法，在低比特率下保持任务性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型进行量化，属于本站主题之一。它提出了任务引导的混合精度量化方法，对VLA的高效推理和部署具有直接价值。

papers.abstract: Real-time forecasting of resting-state EEG signals is required by applications like brain-state-dependent stimulation, where computer generated actions are coupled with ongoing neural oscillations. Recently, the deep learning model WaveNet was proposed for the forecasting task. It shows superior accuracy compared to the prevailing method, the linear autoregressive (AR) model, and provides a built-in uncertainty measure due to its probabilistic modeling framework. However, inference using WaveNet is too slow for real-time use due to its sample-by-sample autoregressive operation: a single forecast requires evaluating the model tens or hundreds of times depending on the length of the prediction window. In this paper, we present REVBRAIN, a probabilistic deep learning method that produces forecasts in real time by generating the forecast over the whole prediction horizon at once. This is achieved by tokenizing the output space using residual vector quantization (RVQ) and generating forecasts over the items in the tokenized space. We tested REVBRAIN for forecasting 200 ms of EEG time series in the alpha-frequency band (8-13 Hz) and compared our results against WaveNet model. We found that REVBRAIN achieved real-time inference on a laptop GPU and an over $50\times$ speedup compared to WaveNet, while reaching superior prediction accuracy. By achieving real-time inference speed, REVBRAIN enables incorporating accurate and probabilistic EEG forecasting into BCI applications, opening up new ways for investigating the functioning of the human brain.

analysis.key_results: 在预测200毫秒alpha频段（8-13 Hz）EEG信号时，REVBRAIN在笔记本GPU上实现实时推理，速度比WaveNet快50倍以上，且预测精度更高。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出REVBRAIN方法，通过残差向量量化将输出空间令牌化，一次性生成整个预测窗口，实现实时EEG预测。
analysis.method: 使用残差向量量化（RVQ）对输出空间进行令牌化，然后生成令牌化空间中的整个预测序列。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出REVBRAIN，一种利用残差向量量化实现一次性生成整个预测窗口的实时概率EEG预测方法。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文关注EEG预测的实时推理，不直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人动作-世界建模；但其模型量化与高效推理方法对本站主题具有方法学参考价值。

papers.title: REVBRAIN: Real-time Probabilistic EEG Forecasting Using Residual Vector Quantization
papers.title_zh: REVBRAIN：基于残差向量量化的实时概率EEG预测

papers.abstract: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) learn to predict representations rather than pixels, offering a compact way to model how visual scenes evolve. We ask whether this predictive objective improves closed-loop control when a vision-language-action (VLA) policy already uses V-JEPA features. We call our JEPA-conditioned flow policy family SaiVLA-JEPA. It combines a vision-language model with a diffusion transformer action expert and receives features from a frozen V-JEPA encoder. Two lightweight auxiliary heads predict future representations during training and are omitted at inference, leaving the action sampler unchanged. We compare policies without JEPA features, with current JEPA conditioning, and with additional future supervision on 10,030 paired LIBERO-Plus episodes. Current JEPA conditioning reaches about 82.5% success versus 71.6% without JEPA, while future supervision provides no detectable aggregate gain at the evaluated training budget. We separately evaluate SaiVLA-JEPA-TCA, which adapts latent context, and SaiVLA-JEPA-TPA, which adapts selected parameters. The context-retry gain is a system-level result under a larger attempt budget; parameter adaptation shows no consistent advantage over the frozen policy and target controls. These results motivate assessing latent-prediction objectives through paired closed-loop rollouts rather than latent loss alone.

analysis.key_results: 当前JEPA条件下的成功率约82.5%，无JEPA为71.6%；未来监督在训练预算内无显著聚合增益。SaiVLA-JEPA-TCA在更大尝试预算下有效，TPA相比冻结策略无一致优势。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出SaiVLA-JEPA策略家族，在VLA策略中引入V-JEPA特征，并加入未来表示预测辅助头，考察预测性目标对闭环控制的作用。
analysis.method: 将V-JEPA特征与扩散Transformer动作专家集成到VLA模型中，训练时添加两个轻量辅助头预测未来表示，推理时省略。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文研究了在视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略中使用联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）特征以及未来潜变量预测对闭环控制的影响。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接研究VLA策略（JEPA特征与动作预测）的性能，属于主体研究范围；通过配对闭环评估强调潜在预测目标的实际价值，与机器人学习高度相关。

papers.abstract: To solve problems in 3D space rather than merely describe images, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) need 3D spatiotemporal reasoning: reconstructing 3D geometry from occluded 2D views, anticipating physical dynamics, and executing precise, closed-loop actions. Prior studies test passive VQA on static images or symbolic planning, requiring no execution or supplying privileged coordinates while ignoring collision, statics, and timing. We introduce SpaceAct, an interactive benchmark evaluating 3D spatiotemporal reasoning via closed-loop physical action and active perception, with SAPA, a Spatiotemporal Active-Probing Agent framework. Built on interlocking bricks and mechanical puzzles, it has 108 verified instances across 36 task families in six categories, without privileged coordinates, and diagnostic modes (+plan, +state, no-camera, blind, L7 levers). In brick-bridging or aperture-threading, models rotate the camera to resolve occlusion, read in-scene rulers, output 6-DoF poses under swept-collision and statics checks, and self-correct via split-screen rollback feedback (dynamic tasks freeze time during deliberation and give five strobe frames). Across 10 frontier MLLMs on the 44 hardest instances, scores span 4.8-79.1 (seven solve at most 27.3% of 6-DoF tasks); for the top three, a reference plan (+plan) closes 44% of the gap while leaving collisions at 5.2 per episode, whereas adding exact 3D state (+state) closes 90% and cuts collisions to 0.5; for four others, +plan lifts the mean score from 10.9 to 35.3 and +state to 81.8; and 46% of failures are collision or observation loops. SpaceAct and SAPA advance evaluation to closed-loop physical interaction, showing that even with a valid plan, MLLMs remain bottlenecked by 3D visual grounding and action refinement, while offering a testbed for active multi-view exploration and explicit 3D grounding.

analysis.key_results: 在44个最难实例上，10个前沿多模态大语言模型得分介于4.8-79.1；前三个模型借助参考计划(+plan)缩小44%差距但仍有每回合5.2次碰撞，添加精确3D状态(+state)后缩小90%差距且碰撞降至0.5；另有四个模型+plan后平均分从10.9升至35.3，+state后升至81.8；46%的失败源于碰撞或观测循环。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出SpaceAct基准和SAPA主动探测代理框架，包含108个验证实例，覆盖36个任务族，无需特权坐标，支持多模态大语言模型在闭环物理交互下的3D时空推理评估。
analysis.method: 构建基于互锁积木和机械拼图的交互式环境，模型通过旋转相机解决遮挡、读取尺子、输出带碰撞检测和静力学检查的6-DoF位姿，并利用分屏回滚反馈和五帧频闪进行自我纠正。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: SpaceAct是一个面向多模态大语言模型的3D时空推理交互式基准，通过闭环物理动作和主动感知来评估模型在遮挡重建、动态预测和六自由度动作执行上的能力。

papers.abstract: Discretizing continuous actions into discrete skills using methods like VQ-VAE has emerged as a powerful paradigm for robotic manipulation. However, quantization errors yield a suboptimal distribution for the skill prior, degrading its performance. While reinforcement learning offers a path for refinement, its direct application faces unstable encoder updates and a granularity dilemma in importance sampling. To address these challenges, we introduce Cascaded Skills Optimization (CSO), a two-stage post-training framework. First, Rejection-Sampling Supervised Fine-tuning aligns the model's observation-to-skill mapping with the distribution of successful online trajectories via supervised fine-tuning. Second, with the observation encoder frozen, Skills Policy Optimization computes an independent, clipped importance ratio for each complete skill, enabling stable and efficient updates. With a lightweight QueST-style policy, CSO raises overall LIBERO success from 80.1% to 97.5%, improves performance on RoboTwin2.0, and achieves 61.0% success across five physical single-arm tasks. Additional comparisons with FAST, discrete BEAST, and fixed-buffer IQL further validate the effectiveness of our two-stage post-training strategy.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO上将总体成功率从80.1%提升至97.5%，在RoboTwin2.0上性能提升，在五个物理单臂任务上实现61.0%成功率；与FAST、离散BEAST、固定缓冲IQL的比较验证了有效性。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出级联技能优化（CSO）两阶段后训练框架，通过拒绝采样监督微调对齐技能分布，并在冻结观测编码器的情况下进行技能粒度策略优化，提升离散技能机器人策略的性能。
analysis.method: 两阶段后训练：第一阶段拒绝采样监督微调对齐观测-技能映射与成功轨迹分布；第二阶段冻结观测编码器，针对每个完整技能计算独立裁剪的重要性比率进行策略优化。

papers.abstract: Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) is now a common ingredient in language-model pre-training, as it improves downstream performance and enables faster inference through speculative decoding. We identify a flaw in standard MTP training, in which a residual component of the MTP gradient interferes with both next-token and multi-token learning, increasingly so with scale. Specifically, the MTP cross-entropy gradient can be decomposed exactly into a KL self-distillation term that pulls each MTP head toward the model's own next-token prediction (NTP) distribution and improves speculative decoding, and a residual that has a low signal-to-noise ratio and buries the useful KL signal. We introduce the KL gradient-recovery trick: when two distributions share a linear output head, the gradient of their KL divergence can be recovered exactly by combining their cross-entropy gradients through straight-through gradient routing. Unlike minimizing the KL directly, this trick requires no vocabulary-sized logit matrices and is compatible with standard fused cross-entropy kernels. This enables Soft Multi-Token Prediction (Soft-MTP), a one-line code change to MTP that removes the noisy residual and backpropagates only the KL self-distillation signal by reusing the existing NTP and MTP cross-entropy computations. Soft-MTP supports both DeepSeek- and Meta-style MTP, adds no parameters, and incurs no measurable overhead. From 167M to 1.2B parameters, Soft-MTP improves over standard MTP with lower NTP perplexity, faster speculative decoding and higher zero-shot accuracy at every scale, lower MTP perplexity from 689M onward, and stronger math and code reasoning after fine-tuning at 1.2B. Soft-MTP also matches, if not exceeds, direct KL divergence minimization on most metrics. Soft-MTP is, in effect, a free lunch for MTP optimization. Our code can be found at https://github.com/JaydenTeoh/Soft-MTP.

analysis.key_results: 在167M至1.2B参数规模上，Soft-MTP相比标准MTP实现了更低的NTP困惑度、更快的推测解码、更高的零样本准确率，从689M开始MTP困惑度更低，并在1.2B参数微调后获得更强的数学和代码推理能力。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Soft-MTP，一种对多Token预测(MTP)训练的一行代码改进，通过恢复KL自蒸馏梯度，消除标准MTP损失中的噪声残差，从而提高模型质量并加速推测解码。
analysis.method: 利用KL梯度恢复技巧，通过直通梯度路由组合现有的NTP和MTP交叉熵梯度来精确恢复KL散度梯度，无需词汇量大小的logit矩阵，并兼容标准融合交叉熵核。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 论文提出Soft Multi-Token Prediction (Soft-MTP)，通过KL梯度恢复技巧去除标准MTP训练中的噪声残差，从而提升语言模型性能和推测解码速度。

papers.abstract: AI compute is becoming large and fast-changing electrical loads. Its impacts on data center infrastructure and power grids depend not only on total energy consumption, but also on how their power draw moves over sub-second to minute timescales, including peaks, ramps, and synchronized fluctuations across accelerators. Existing energy benchmarks for large language models (LLMs) report aggregate quantities such as joules per token and rarely release the underlying time-series measurements, leaving these power dynamics poorly characterized and difficult to model. We introduce LLM-PowerTrace, an open dataset of time-resolved, per-GPU power traces for LLM fine-tuning and inference, sampled every 100\,ms on varying NVIDIA platforms paired with complete workload and system metadata. For fine-tuning, LLM-PowerTrace profiles open model families spanning a wide range of model sizes and fine-tuning methods, together with controlled sweeps over batch size, sequence length, precision, parallelism, and checkpointing. For inference, it covers variations in concurrency, GPU frequency, KV-cache and weight quantization, prompt and output lengths, and request-arrival patterns. LLM-PowerTrace profiles a set of open model families across a wide range of model sizes, and controlled sweeps over batch size, sequence length, precision, parallelism, and checkpointing for fine-tuning, and it sweeps concurrency, GPU frequency, KV cache and weight quantization, prompt and output lengths, and request arrival patterns for inference. Built upon power traces, we define power-grid-facing metrics as well as AI-compute power\&energy scaling law for extrapolating beyond the measured settings. Together, LLM-PowerTrace provides a dataset foundation for modeling, forecasting, and managing the fast-changing electrical behavior of AI compute.

papers.abstract: Pneumonia changes across respiration, inflammation, and organ function, while the measurements that describe it arrive at different times and are often incomplete. We introduce PULMOWORLD, a world model for longitudinal pneumonia dynamics that connects asynchronous state estimation, recursive simulation, and evidence-constrained planning. History-aware filtering separates state propagation from observation-driven correction, so a measurement updates the shared belief only when it is observed. That belief supports recursive forecasts of clinical values and modality representations, and summaries of future prognosis. Cap-MBRL searches imagined continuations inside an authorized action set and replaces a frozen fallback only when a candidate meets the risk budget and a predicted-cost margin. On the pneumonia cohort MASS, recursive forecasts are competitive with task-trained sequence models, and simulated future states retain prognostic information. Trained separately on public MIMIC-IV-CXR chest radiographs and clinical trajectories, this model improves prognostic discrimination over latest-value fusion in development and is competitive on long-horizon error on the locked pneumonia panel. In five known-mechanism MASS-Syn environments, Cap-MBRL lowers selection regret relative to direct fallback execution.

analysis.key_results: 在肺炎队列 MASS 上，递归预测与任务训练序列模型相当；在 MIMIC-IV-CXR 和临床轨迹上训练后，开发集上预后判别优于最新值融合，锁定肺炎面板上长程误差有竞争力；在五个已知机制的 MASS-Syn 环境中，Cap-MBRL 降低选择遗憾。

papers.abstract: Loss spikes in language model pretraining can waste substantial compute and derail otherwise healthy training runs. A primary driver of these instabilities is the growth and divergence of output logits in the final language modeling (LM) head. In this work, we study a particularly costly form of this instability associated with output logit growth: delayed, terminal divergences that emerge only after prolonged training, which we call time-bomb spikes. We find that these instabilities are preceded by rapidly growing quantization error in the LM head, which eventually culminates in a loss spike. Crucially, reducing numerical precision accelerates time-bomb spikes, while increasing precision improves stability. We then propose a simple yet effective mitigation that replaces AdamW on the LM head with SGD with momentum, suppressing logit growth and improving stability over long training horizons. Finally, we find that existing mitigation techniques from the literature (along with our own) all reduce quantization error, suggesting a shared numerical mechanism behind their effectiveness. Together, our results identify finite precision error as a hidden driver of time-bomb spikes and show that suppressing this error is key to stable long-horizon pretraining.

analysis.key_results: 降低数值精度会加速time-bomb spikes，提高精度可改善稳定性；所提出的SGD with momentum方法能有效抑制logit增长，并提升长期训练稳定性；现有缓解技术均通过降低量化误差发挥作用。
analysis.main_contribution: 发现量化误差是延迟性损失尖峰的隐藏驱动因素，并提出用SGD with momentum替换LM head上的AdamW以抑制logit增长并改善长期训练稳定性。
analysis.method: 分析语言模型预训练中的logit增长和量化误差，将AdamW替换为SGD with momentum以抑制logit增长。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文研究语言模型预训练中由量化误差驱动的损失尖峰（time-bomb spikes），并提出用带动量的SGD替换AdamW来抑制logit增长以提升稳定性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文针对语言模型预训练中的量化误差和训练稳定性，不直接涉及VLA或WAM，但与模型量化（本站主题之一）高度相关，其关于低精度训练稳定性的发现可为机器人策略或世界模型的量化训练提供参考。

figures.caption: Reduced precision accelerates time-bomb spikes, while LM head SGD-M prevents them. Lowering LM head precision brings the failure earlier, with BF16 true diverging first, BF16 mixed later, and FP32 remaining stable throughout training ( left ). Output logit norm grows under every AdamW baseline, including FP32 ( middle ), but it destabilizes training only in reduced precision, where LM head quantization error grows by orders of magnitude before each failure ( right ). Quantization error is measured as the RMS difference between native BF16 logits and FP32 logits computed from the same hidden states. Replacing AdamW with SGD-M on the LM head keeps both logit norm and quantization error nearly flat, preventing the time bomb even in BF16 mixed precision. Results are for 28M parameter models trained at peak learning rate 0.1 0.1 for ∼ 28 × {\sim}28\times the Chinchilla optimal token horizon, using AdamW throughout (baselines) or SGD with momentum on the LM head (SGD-M).

papers.abstract: Mobile manipulator robots rarely reposition their base during manipulation, because doing so requires real-time knowledge of how well the arm can reach its surroundings among obstacles. Reachability maps (RMs) encode this knowledge, but existing methods are slow, coarse (typically 5 cm), or ignore real obstacles. This article asks whether a neural network can predict an obstacle-aware RM at 2 cm resolution from a live depth camera, on embedded hardware, fast enough for online use. We present HERON, a 3D U-Net trained on RMs computed with the GPU-accelerated inverse kinematics of cuRobo, first on synthetic scenes and then on real depth data, and deployed on a Jetson AGX Orin with TensorRT and INT8 quantization. HERON predicts the RM of a 2.56 m cube around the arm in 115 ms on average, for a measured system rate of 8.57 Hz, close to the 10 Hz update rate of the obstacle map, whereas computing the same map with cuRobo takes about 90 min. Against the cuRobo ground truth, 95% of the voxels lie within 1 class out of 51 with the FP32 model and within 3 classes with the INT8 model, with a Pearson correlation of 0.99 and a quadratic weighted kappa above 0.9. Accuracy degrades mainly at the workspace boundaries.

analysis.key_results: HERON 平均耗时 115 ms 预测机械臂周围 2.56 米立方体的可达性图，系统速率为 8.57 Hz；与 cuRobo 真值相比，FP32 模型 95% 的体素误差在 51 类中的 1 类以内，INT8 模型在 3 类以内，Pearson 相关系数为 0.99，二次加权 kappa 高于 0.9。精度主要在可达性图边界处下降。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 HERON，一种在嵌入式设备上实时预测高分辨率、障碍物感知的可达性图的神经网络方法，使移动机械臂能够在操作过程中在线重定位基座。
analysis.method: 3D U-Net 在 GPU 加速逆运动学（cuRobo）生成的可达性图上训练，使用合成场景和真实深度数据，并通过 TensorRT 和 INT8 量化部署在 Jetson AGX Orin 上。

papers.abstract: Weight-only, lossy quantization substantially reduces the storage and memory requirements for serving large language models (LLMs), but the growing key-value (KV) cache remains a bottleneck for long-context inference on personal devices. We present Group-Adaptive Additive Codec (GAAC), a lossless KV compression and serving system that exploits exponent redundancy to reduce storage and accelerate attention without introducing KV approximation. GAAC encodes BF16 exponents using calibrated per-channel base-plus-offset codes over contiguous ranges. GAAC adapts code widths across small groups while preserving KV values bit-for-bit. A fused attention kernel reconstructs KV tiles on the fly, avoiding full-cache decompression. Block-wise compression and fixed-capacity slots support incremental cache updates and paged serving. Across five tested models, GAAC achieves 1.405-1.407$\times$ lossless BF16 KV compression. We also study compression performance on low-precision tensors FP8 E4M3 caches ( 1.09-1.14$\times$) and E5M2 caches (1.25-1.30$\times$). On NVIDIA DGX Spark, GAAC accelerates decode attention at a 64K-token context by 1.19-1.27$\times$ and end-to-end W4A16 decode steps by 1.04-1.15$\times$. In serving, it reduces resident KV memory by approximately 26% and increases aggregate throughput by 13-29% under comparable KV-memory budgets. On Apple M4, GAAC achieves 1.02-1.25$\times$ attention speedups, demonstrating portability beyond NVIDIA GPUs.

analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出一种无损KV缓存压缩系统GAAC，利用指数冗余在不引入近似的情况下降低存储并加速注意力计算。

papers.abstract: Behavior Cloning has demonstrated promising generalization capabilities for robotic manipulation in terrestrial environments. However, marine visual distortions and dynamic currents create a severe domain shift that remains a key bottleneck in adapting generalist architectures to underwater field manipulation. To address this, 1616 episodes of underwater manipulation data were collected in calm and turbulent waters and were used to train 14 generalist Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models (DynamicVLA) with varying proprioception observation configurations. Across three tasks on 1260 gradable on-hardware rollouts in a pool, 10 models outperformed the baseline, with the highest-performing model achieving a 93.3% overall success rate, including partial successes. Results are also introduced from a case study evaluating the performance of a single-task Action Chunking Transformer (ACT) and a generalist VLA (SmolVLA) policy for two tasks in marine archaeology and conservation: grasping and mooring. Experiments are performed on an ROV on and around the WWII wreck Coralita X127 and at Manoel Island Marina, Malta. Across 748 collected episodes and 508 gradable on-hardware rollouts, the ACT policy substantially outperformed SmolVLA (47.9% vs. 7.9% pooled success rate), earning a 66.7% success rate on the most successful task at the marine archaeological site. To enable further contributions to embodied intelligence in marine field robotics, the BLUEMBODIED KIT used to collect data, train models, and deploy policies on the ROV has been open sourced.

analysis.key_results: 在三个任务的1260次可评分硬件部署中，10个模型优于基线，最高总体成功率93.3%；在海洋考古和保护任务中，ACT策略综合成功率47.9%，SmolVLA为7.9%，其中一项任务ACT达到66.7%成功率。

papers.abstract: Web assistants increasingly answer questions about a user's private documents by pairing a small on-device model with a cloud LLM behind a Web API. In collaborative decoding, the document stays on the client, and the cloud receives only a public view that the user approves, such as the question alone, but the two models exchange messages while the answer is generated. We show that the message transcript can disclose private content that neither the public view nor the answer contains. In a planted-secret audit, speculative decoding with private drafts did not include the secret code in its answers, yet sent the code to the cloud in rejected drafts. We present ADLER, a decoding protocol for streaming LLM APIs in which every message to the cloud depends only on the public view and the answer the user sees, regardless of how the client combines the two models or how the cloud behaves. A client-side leakage ledger then bounds how much the answer itself reveals relative to a public reference process built from the cloud's replies. In the audit, no ADLER configuration exposed the secret beyond the answer. On GSM8K math problems with numerical values masked in the cloud's input, ADLER with an unlimited leakage budget raises the exact-match accuracy of a 0.5B client from 0.41 to 0.83 and of a 1.5B client from 0.67 to 0.85 under lenient answer parsing, close to the 0.92 achieved by uploading the full problem. It also exceeds a zero-leakage program baseline (0.69) by 0.14 and 0.16, respectively. In this baseline, the cloud writes a program that the client runs offline using the private numbers. The ledger records the disclosure charge associated with this gain; budgets of 16 nats or less leave accuracy near the cloud-only baseline on GSM8K.

analysis.key_results: 在GSM8K数学问题中，对云端输入屏蔽数值后，使用ADLER和无限泄漏预算，0.5B客户端准确率从0.41提升到0.83，1.5B客户端从0.67提升到0.85；泄漏预算为16纳特或更低时，准确率接近仅云端基线。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出ADLER解码协议和客户端泄漏账本，确保发送到云端的每条消息仅依赖于公开视图和用户可见的答案，并量化答案相对参考过程的额外泄漏。
analysis.method: ADLER协议，其中客户端与云端模型协作，每次向云端发送的消息只包含公开视图信息和已向用户展示的答案部分；采用泄漏账本记录和限制私有信息暴露。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 论文提出一种名为ADLER的协作解码协议，用于在保持客户端私有文档不出域的前提下通过Web API调用云端LLM，并限制消息传输中的信息泄漏。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 文章不涉及视觉-语言-动作模型或世界模型，但其对推测解码中隐私泄漏的审计以及提出的泄漏控制协议，对在资源受限设备上部署包含推测解码的高效推理系统具有方法学参考价值。

papers.abstract: We introduce Nemotron 3.5 Super and Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, open and efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer models designed for reasoning, long-context understanding, and agentic workloads. Super is a 120B-parameter, 12B-active multimodal model, while Lightning is a smaller 30B-parameter, 3B-active text model; both designed for efficient deployment. Both models combine large-scale distillation, long-context training, and native speculative decoding, while Super further incorporates Indic continued pretraining and agentic software-engineering mid-training. We develop a comprehensive post-training pipeline spanning supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning (RLVR and RLHF), complemented in Super by specialized teacher training and multi- teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). This transforms Super from a text-only base model into a multimodal agent capable of reasoning over text, images, video, and interactive tool environments. We further explore test-time scaling through parallel agent execution and self-verification. Across training and deployment, we jointly optimize capability and efficiency. Indic continued pretraining improves Indian-language benchmarks by up to 9.82 percentage points, while agentic mid-training strengthens software-engineering capabilities and robustness across agent harnesses. The post-trained Super model achieves 51.78% on SWE-bench Pro, surpassing Nemotron 3 Ultra despite using approximately 4.6x fewer active parameters. Post-training MTP boosting improves speculative- decoding acceptance length by up to 21.8% under probabilistic draft sampling, while NVFP4 quantization achieves 99.62% median accuracy recovery relative to BF16. Inference optimizations enable up to 4,856 output tokens/s/GPU on GB200 while sustaining at least 50 tokens/s/user.

analysis.key_results: Indic继续预训练在印度语言基准上最高提升9.82个百分点；Super在SWE-bench Pro上达到51.78%，超越Nemotron 3 Ultra且激活参数少约4.6倍；后训练MTP提升推测解码接受长度最高21.8%；NVFP4量化相对BF16实现99.62%的中位精度恢复；推理优化在GB200上实现高达4856 tokens/s/GPU，同时每用户维持至少50 tokens/s。
analysis.main_contribution: 开发了Nemotron 3.5 Super（120B参数、12B激活的多模态模型）和Lightning（30B参数、3B激活的文本模型），结合大规模蒸馏、长上下文训练和原生推测解码，并通过后训练流水线增强智能体能力。
analysis.method: 混合专家Hybrid Mamba-Transformer架构；结合大规模蒸馏、长上下文训练、原生推测解码、监督微调和强化学习（RLVR和RLHF）、多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）、并行智能体执行和自验证；Super额外进行Indic继续预训练和智能体软件工程中期训练。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文介绍了两种开放且高效的混合专家Hybrid Mamba-Transformer模型，面向推理、长上下文理解和智能体工作负载。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文关注通用高效模型和推理优化，包括推测解码和量化，但与视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型或世界-动作模型无直接联系；其多模态Agent能力可能对具身智能有借鉴意义，但未明确针对机器人策略学习或世界建模。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies can learn to follow execution preferences, such as where to grasp an object or how to move around an obstacle, from demonstrations annotated with preference labels. Providing these annotations for every new task, however, is costly. We study whether learned preference control can transfer to new tasks whose demonstrations contain the desired behaviors but lack preference annotations. We find that a policy trained with preference annotations can follow preferences on a new task before adaptation but achieves limited task success. Fine-tuning on target demonstrations without these annotations improves task success while weakening preference control. Motivated by this finding, we introduce Self-Labeled Preference Transfer (SPT). SPT jointly trains a shared vision-language backbone for preference-conditioned action prediction and preference recognition on annotated source demonstrations. It then freezes the recognizer to preserve its cross-task preference recognition capability and uses it to self-label target demonstrations for policy fine-tuning. Across five types of execution preferences in simulation, the recognizer achieves 96.4% accuracy, and SPT reaches 84.8% preference following and 89.2% task success, compared with 59.4% and 88.0% for naive finetuning. We further extend to multiple preferences, achieving 93.8% preference following compared with 42.5% of baselines. In real-world experiments, SPT increases preference following from 52.5% to 92.5% relative to naive finetuning across two task transfers. These results show that SPT can support preference adaptation across tasks and objects while maintaining success, without additional manual preference annotations.

analysis.key_results: 在仿真五种执行偏好中，识别器准确率96.4%，SPT偏好跟随84.8%、任务成功率89.2%，对比朴素微调的59.4%和88.0%；多偏好设置下偏好跟随93.8%（基线42.5%）；真实实验中偏好跟随从52.5%提升至92.5%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出自标注偏好迁移（SPT）方法，通过冻结偏好识别器为无标注的目标演示自标注偏好，实现执行偏好跨任务迁移而无需额外人工标注。
analysis.method: SPT联合训练共享视觉语言骨干用于偏好条件动作预测和偏好识别，在源任务标注上训练后冻结识别器，用于为目标任务演示自标注偏好，再进行策略微调。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 研究视觉语言动作策略中执行偏好的跨任务迁移，提出自标注偏好迁移方法，无需新任务偏好标注即可保持偏好跟随和任务成功率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该研究直接致力于VLA策略的执行偏好控制与跨任务迁移，属于机器人操作中的视觉-语言-动作学习，虽未涉及WAM，但对VLA的高效适应与行为可控性具有核心意义。

papers.abstract: Time-series data play an important role in various tasks, such as weather forecasting, web traffic analysis, and speech recognition. Recently, pioneering studies have increasingly adopted Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) based encoders to learn time-series representations through latent-space prediction. However, they often overlook the underlying factors governing transitions between time-series observations. In this work, we hypothesize that explicitly modeling the information behind changes in time series can facilitate time-series modeling. Building on this hypothesis, we propose ACTS-WM, a self-supervised latent action-conditioned world model framework for time-series analysis. First, we introduce a latent action modeling approach that infers the underlying information behind time-series transitions as latent actions, without requiring explicit action annotations. We then develop a JEPA-based encoder and an action-conditioned world model to predict target time-series representations conditioned on the learned latent actions and task information. We evaluate ACTS-WM across 4 representative tasks on 22 datasets from diverse domains, covering univariate and multivariate forecasting and classification. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that ACTS-WM can improve downstream performance over pretrained JEPA-based encoders by learning complementary representations.

analysis.key_results: 在22个数据集、4个任务（单变量/多变量预测和分类）上的实验表明，ACTS-WM可通过学习互补表示提升预训练JEPA编码器的下游性能。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出ACTS-WM，一个自监督潜在动作条件世界模型框架，通过推断潜在动作来建模时间序列变化。
analysis.method: 引入潜在动作建模方法，在不需显式动作标注的情况下推断潜在动作；开发基于JEPA的编码器和动作条件世界模型，根据学习到的潜在动作和任务信息预测目标表示。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种自监督潜在动作条件世界模型框架ACTS-WM，用于时间序列分析。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作涉及动作条件世界模型，但其主要针对通用时间序列分析，并非机器人或具身智能场景中的视觉-语言-动作世界模型；但方法论上对动作条件世界建模和自监督表示学习有潜在借鉴价值。

(b) JEPA-based time-series encoders learn representations without explicit action conditioning. (c) ACTS-WM learns latent actions from observational time series, enabling action-conditioned world modeling for time-series analysis without requiring explicit action signals.

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer a promising paradigm for general-purpose household robotics. However, inference and data-collection strategies that have been deployed in smaller-scale settings do not necessarily generalize to large-scale, diverse task suites. To address this gap, we conduct a systematic, paired evaluation of previously proposed inference and data-collection strategies across all 100 tasks. Our evaluation uses a fine-tuned $\pi_{0.5}$ model based on the 2025 BEHAVIOR Challenge winner, which achieves a Q-score of 0.39 on the public test set. These results show that proposed strategies do not transfer uniformly to new environments and tasks. Project page, videos, and detailed analysis: https://rubenhammele.github.io/behavior2026

analysis.key_results: 先前提出的策略不能在新环境和新任务中一致地迁移；该模型在公共测试集上达到Q-score 0.39。
analysis.main_contribution: 对先前提出的推理和数据收集策略在全部100个任务上的可迁移性进行了系统性配对评估，揭示了这些策略不能在新环境和新任务中一致地迁移。
analysis.method: 使用基于2025 BEHAVIOR Challenge冠军微调后的π0.5模型，在BEHAVIOR-1K全部100个任务上进行配对评估，并对推理与数据收集策略进行系统比较。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文对BEHAVIOR-1K全100个任务上的π0.5 VLA模型进行了推理与数据收集策略的系统配对评估。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接评估VLA模型（π0.5）在大规模家庭机器人任务基准（BEHAVIOR-1K）上的推理策略，属于VLA系统的实证评估，对本站主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Distributed fire-monitoring systems may involve many sensing devices reporting over a shared uplink, even though the operational objective is often to identify regions exhibiting evidence of fire rather than to recover device-specific measurements. We introduce TERRA (Task-Oriented Edge Representation and Regional Aggregation), an edge-AI framework that combines task-oriented local inference, identity-free region-tagged reporting, and permutation-invariant regional evidence aggregation. TERRA supports two reporting modes: TERRA-Score, in which each device communicates a quantized local fire probability, and TERRA-Feature, in which it communicates a compact learned representation for receiver-side aggregation using a permutation-invariant DeepSets model. Using all 15 numerical sensing modalities of the distributed indoor EN54 fire-alarm dataset as a proof-of-concept testbed, we evaluate regional inference for an episode-level fire-scenario target under repetition-disjoint three-fold cross-validation. We study representation size, task-payload quantization, report availability, and robustness to missed and false recovered messages. With nine reports and perfect message recovery, TERRA-Feature achieves mean AUPRC 0.990 using a 24-bit task payload, while TERRA-Score achieves 0.987 using only 6 bits; both attain an MDR of 1.81% at FAR $\leq$1%. TERRA-Feature achieves slightly higher AUPRC under reliable recovery, whereas the more compact TERRA-Score is less sensitive to increasing false-message contamination.

analysis.key_results: 在EN54火灾告警数据集上，TERRA-Feature以24比特负载达AUPRC 0.990，TERRA-Score以6比特达AUPRC 0.987；两者均在FAR≤1%时达到1.81%的漏检率。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了TERRA框架，将任务导向的边缘推断、身份无关的区域报告与置换不变的证据聚合相结合，用于区域级火灾检测。
analysis.method: TERRA-Score（设备上报量化局部火灾概率）与TERRA-Feature（设备上报紧凑学习表示，接收端用置换不变DeepSets聚合）。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: TERRA是一种用于分布式火灾监测系统的边缘AI框架，结合任务导向的本地推断、无身份区域标记报告和置换不变的证据聚合，支持量化概率或紧凑特征两种报告模式。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文研究边缘推理中的模型量化与紧凑表示，不涉及VLA或WAM，但与本站关注的模型量化主题有方法论上的间接价值，可用于高效边缘推理。

Devices transmit either a quantized local score (TERRA-Score) or a learned representation (TERRA-Feature), together with a region tag and a nonce; recovered reports are grouped by region and aggregated using score averaging or DeepSets, respectively. TERRA architecture with distributed multimodal sensing nodes performing local score or feature extraction, transmitting region-tagged reports over an identity-free URA uplink, and a receiver grouping recovered reports by region for score averaging or permutation-invariant DeepSets aggregation.

papers.abstract: On PushT, our fixed action updater (1,505 parameters) solves 8 of 16 scenes reserved from our configuration selection. The comparison planners perform as follows: Selected Adam (7 tasks solved, total planning and encoding time 218.440s), adapted iCEM (2 tasks solved, total planning and encoding time 49.309s), released LePlanner (16 tasks solved, total planning and encoding time 5.652s). The total planning and encoding time for our action updater is 59.079s. Note that our action updater does not satisfy the task-cost criterion we fixed before evaluation. We also conduct another matched experiment where we only replay the first ten commands in each context and then allow the next solve 4, 8 or 12 updates (subsequent solves all get 8 updates). Among all 16 contexts (8 scene clusters), the 3 budgets get 9, 8 and 7 successes, respectively. Interestingly, the extra updates did not rescue any failing task in this experiment. All the changes in success/failure happen in one scene cluster, where we observe that the extra updates decrease the costs of the selected latent world-model trajectories for our updater, while the tasks that used to be successes become failures. The code, weights, evaluators, execution traces and cost accounting accompany the paper.

analysis.key_results: 在PushT的16个保留场景中，固定动作更新器解决了8个；Selected Adam解决7个（总规划与编码时间218.440秒），adapted iCEM解决2个（49.309秒），released LePlanner解决16个（5.652秒）。固定动作更新器的总规划与编码时间为59.079秒，且不满足预先设定的任务成本准则。在匹配实验中，额外更新未挽救任何失败任务，且在一个场景簇中导致原本成功任务变为失败。
analysis.limitations: 固定动作更新器不满足预先设定的任务成本准则；在额外更新的消融实验中，更多更新导致某些原本成功任务失败。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种参数极少（1,505个）的固定动作更新器，可作为世界模型中的学习型规划器，并对其在PushT任务上的性能进行了实验评估。
analysis.method: 使用固定动作更新器在PushT环境中与世界模型结合进行规划，并与多种基线规划器（Selected Adam、adapted iCEM、released LePlanner）进行比较；还进行了受限回放和额外更新次数的消融实验。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 论文提出一种轻量级固定动作更新器，在PushT环境中与世界模型结合进行规划，并与Adam、iCEM和LePlanner等基线在成功率和规划时间上进行了对比。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文围绕世界模型中的规划策略展开，对世界模型（World Model）在机器人任务中的应用有直接参考价值，但未提及视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）或WAM作为独立主题，因此与VLA/WAM无直接关系。

figures.caption: Similar block poses can hide a failed goal. In scene 18651, the official predictor gets a ten-command history and follows the plans with four and twelve updates. For the plan with four updates, the task succeeds at command 25. For the plan with twelve updates, the selected score is lower and the task fails at command 50. This is the only solve that differs between these two settings; in all other solves, eight updates were used. Success requires matching not only the block position and orientation, but also the pusher position. The recorded poses at the end of the episode are used to check the pusher's distance from the goal and the joint position error. The two displayed angle errors are both within tolerance. In the figure, gold marks the goals in the dataset; blue and black show the recorded block and pusher poses, respectively; dotted lines indicate the pusher position error. All results in the matched experiment for every scene/model/effort combination are shown in the bottom panel. The scene in which there is a difference is highlighted.

Shown are (left) number of successful tasks (out of sixteen total scenes) and (right) total planning and encoding time (in seconds; note that the sum includes unsuccessful tasks and the cold cost), using linear axes with different units, for four controllers that use different computations. In terms of the practical criterion, the updater fails against more traditional control approaches, and note that here LePlanner is being assessed as a complete controller.

papers.title: When More Planning Hurts: Learned Planners for World Models
papers.title_zh: 当更多规划适得其反：面向世界模型的学习型规划器

papers.abstract: Speculative decoding is used to reduce the inference cost of language models. One-step diffusion drafters propose a block of multiple tokens in parallel, reducing the sequential cost of speculative decoding. On-policy distillation trains these drafters using verifier feedback on their own proposals. However, parallel drafting makes this feedback difficult to use: the drafter predicts each token without observing the preceding tokens sampled within the same block, while the verifier conditions its prediction on those tokens. Different sampled prefixes therefore give different verifier targets for the same drafter prediction. We show that distilling against these targets separately can suppress tokens that are plausible after some prefixes but unlikely after others, harming draft acceptance. We explain the effects of this mismatch and introduce Multi-Draft On-Policy Distillation (MDraft), a new parallel drafter distillation method which samples several draft blocks from the same context and aggregates the verifier's full-vocabulary conditionals across their prefixes. We use all the drafts to collect information from the verifier, allowing support from alternative prefixes to influence the training target. The resulting algorithm improves the acceptance length of a parallel drafter beyond the level of pre-training, and alleviates the effects of the distributional mismatch. MDraft changes only training, retaining the drafter's architecture and inference procedure, allowing the resulting drafter to be used as-is in place of the pretrained checkpoint. Experiments on a suite of mathematical, coding, and conversational tasks show longer accepted drafts than prior distillation methods.

analysis.key_results: 在数学、编码和对话任务上的实验表明，MDraft实现的接受草稿长度优于先前的蒸馏方法，并减轻了分布不匹配的影响。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Multi-Draft On-Policy Distillation (MDraft)，一种新的并行草稿器蒸馏方法，通过采样多个草稿块并聚合验证器的全词表条件分布来解决并行草稿中前缀不匹配导致的训练目标不一致问题。
analysis.method: MDraft从同一上下文采样多个草稿块，聚合验证器在这些不同前缀上的全词表条件分布，使替代前缀的支持影响训练目标，从而训练并行扩散草稿器。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种新的并行草稿器蒸馏方法MDraft，通过采样多个草稿块并聚合验证器的条件分布来训练扩散草稿器，从而提高接受长度。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于语言模型的高效推理中的推测解码扩散草稿器蒸馏，没有直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人学习；其方法仅针对语言模型，对本站主题无直接关系。

The evaluation uses 1,656 prompts from GSM8K, MBPP and MT-Bench. Shaded bands denote 95% confidence intervals. Positions index the 15 drafted tokens. papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have made substantial progress in robotic manipulation, but their generalization remains constrained by the diversity and coverage of action-labeled robot demonstrations. Human videos provide much broader behavioral and environmental experience, while learning from them faces a fundamental trade-off between scalable data and explicit action grounding. We introduce ThinkWorld, a VLA learning framework that grounds action reasoning in world dynamics and strengthens it through reinforcement learning with world imagination. ThinkWorld represents each action thought as a Chain-of-Dynamics (CoD), a sequence of discrete motion tokens that captures the intermediate dynamics connecting the current world to a future state and serves as a common action representation across embodiments. We first initialize CoD with action-labeled demonstrations, then predict the future induced by each CoD and reinforce those whose predictions better match the observed outcome. This enables videos without action annotations to provide direct supervision from observed state transitions, allowing human and robot experience to refine the same reasoning space. Experiments in simulation and on real robots demonstrate effective human-to-robot transfer and strong generalization to unseen tasks and environments.

analysis.key_results: 在仿真和真实机器人上验证了有效的人到机器人迁移，以及对未见任务和环境的强泛化能力。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出ThinkWorld框架，引入链式动力学（CoD）作为跨具身的动作表示，并通过世界想象强化学习利用无动作标注的人类视频，实现有效的人机迁移和泛化。
analysis.method: 将每个动作思维表示为离散运动token序列（Chain-of-Dynamics），先用机器人演示初始化，再预测未来状态并与观察结果比对进行强化，从而让无标注视频提供监督。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出ThinkWorld框架，通过链式动力学表示动作推理，并利用世界想象强化学习从未标注人类视频中学习，提升VLA模型的泛化能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接聚焦于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，提出动作推理与世界动力学相结合的框架，并通过世界想象强化学习提升策略学习，与本站VLA和世界模型主题高度相关。

figures.caption: We introduce ThinkWorld , a vision-language-action framework that learns transferable Chain-of-Dynamics (CoD) reasoning from diverse human and robot experiences. CoD captures action-induced dynamics across embodiments and is reinforced through future imagination, enabling robust generalization in the real world and skill composition guided by human videos.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: ThinkWorld architecture and training stages. In stage (a), supervised fine-tuning (SFT) tokenizes robot actions and annotated human hand motions into a unified discrete motion space to ground Chain-of-Dynamics (CoD) reasoning, while CoD-conditioned imagination predicts the future visual feature. In stage (b), reinforcement learning (RL) uses the alignment between imagined and observed futures as a scalable reward for CoD reasoning over human and robot videos, strengthening action reasoning without motion annotations and improving guidance for continuous control.

papers.abstract: Discrete visual tokens represent vision in a discrete form analogous to language, offering a native interface for multimodal modeling under a shared next-token prediction objective. However, quantization error is widely assumed to cause unavoidable semantic loss, fundamentally limiting the semantic fidelity of discrete visual tokens and positioning continuous visual representations as an intrinsic upper bound. Using multimodal understanding as a proxy for semantic fidelity, we revisit this assumption and find quantization error unreliable, as discrete representations with substantially larger errors can achieve better understanding. Instead, the effective bit budget of discrete indices emerges as a key determinant of downstream performance. However, existing quantizers eventually saturate as additional codebooks contribute progressively less semantic information. As one approach to alleviating this saturation, we introduce Factorized Vector Quantization, which quantizes complementary, fixed-dimensional views of the visual feature with symmetric parallel codebooks. It continues to improve at larger bit budgets, ultimately matching continuous visual representations in multimodal understanding. Trained on industrial-scale multimodal data, our model achieves state-of-the-art performance among discrete-representation models, outperforming UniAR and Emu3-Chat by 22.8% and 59.2%, respectively, on a nine-metric average. To our knowledge, it is also the first discrete-representation model competitive with strong continuous-representation models such as Qwen3-VL, including on fine-grained OCR tasks. We further identify the key principles and a practical recipe enabling this competitiveness. These results and insights support the potential of discrete visual representations to underpin large-scale native multimodal foundation models. Code and models are available at https://github.com/hustvl/FVQ

analysis.key_results: 在九项指标平均上，比 UniAR 和 Emu3-Chat 分别提高 22.8% 和 59.2%；据作者所知，是首个在细粒度 OCR 任务上与强连续表示模型（如 Qwen3-VL）具有竞争力的离散表示模型。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 Factorized Vector Quantization (FVQ)，通过对称并行码本量化互补的固定维度视图，缓解离散视觉令牌的饱和问题，实现接近连续表示的语义保真度。
analysis.method: Factorized Vector Quantization (FVQ)：使用对称并行码本量化互补的固定维度视觉特征视图。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 通过提出分解向量量化（FVQ）方法，证明离散视觉令牌在增加有效比特预算后可在多模态理解上达到与连续表示相当的性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文研究离散视觉表示的量化方法及其语义保真度，属于通用视觉-语言模型范畴。它未涉及机器人动作预测、世界模型或视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，与 VLA/WAM 无直接关系，但所提出的量化方法对多模态模型的推理效率与表示压缩具有潜在的方法论价值。

FVQ continues to improve in the high-budget regime and reaches the continuous QwenViT baseline, whereas existing multi-codebook quantizers saturate. (b) Qualitative examples of text recognition at increasing bit budgets. Higher budgets progressively recover the fine-grained textual information required for correct predictions; green and red denote correct and incorrect answers, respectively.

papers.title: Can Discrete Tokens Serve as Semantically Lossless Representations of Visual Signals?

papers.abstract: Chain-of-thought reasoning has substantially advanced video understanding in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, language-based reasoning traces do not provide a reliable mechanism for models to revisit relevant visual evidence, leading to visual forgetting and impairing their ability to reason over video content. Existing approaches maintain visual grounding during reasoning in two main ways: they either refer to evidence using textual coordinates, which specify symbolic locations rather than the visual content itself, or reinsert cropped regions or frames into the multimodal context, preserving visual details at the cost of substantial context expansion. To address these limitations, we introduce VideoLVR, which constructs latent visual evidence from local regions at relevant video moments, thereby providing visual support for intermediate reasoning steps. To supervise latent visual evidence generation, we introduce a visual token prediction objective that formulates visual token reconstruction as prediction over a vocabulary derived from the input video, thereby unifying visual evidence reconstruction and text generation within the same token prediction framework. This shared prediction framework enables MLLMs to reason over interleaved text tokens and latent visual states while integrating evidence from different moments. We further extend VideoLVR to reinforcement learning by treating sampled visual tokens as actions alongside text tokens and jointly optimizing the policy using final-answer rewards. By efficiently revisiting task-relevant visual information during reasoning, VideoLVR improves video understanding without substantially expanding the multimodal context. Experiments on multiple video benchmarks demonstrate its effectiveness, especially on tasks requiring fine-grained visual evidence.

analysis.key_results: 在多个视频基准上验证了有效性，尤其在需要细粒度视觉证据的任务上表现更好。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 VideoLVR，在推理过程中构建潜在视觉证据以缓解视觉遗忘，并统一视觉证据重建与文本生成；进一步将方法扩展到强化学习。
analysis.method: 从相关视频时刻的局部区域构造潜在视觉证据，使用视觉 token 预测目标统一视觉重建与文本生成，并将采样视觉 token 作为动作与文本 token 联合优化。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: VideoLVR 通过构建局部区域的潜在视觉证据来支持视频推理，并引入视觉 token 预测目标，在不过度扩展多模态上下文的情况下提升视频理解。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该方法属于视觉语言模型的视频推理效率优化，虽未直接涉及机器人动作预测或操控，但其对视频中视觉证据的潜在压缩与高效复用，对视觉语言动作模型或机器人世界模型的视觉记忆机制具有一定的参考价值。

figures.caption: Overview of VideoLVR. (a) A teacher MLLM synthesizes evidence-grounded reasoning trajectories through rejection sampling and trajectory polishing. (b) Visual tokens from regions supporting the same reasoning step are grouped and ordered by timestamp to form latent targets. VideoLVR jointly trains text generation with next-token prediction and latent visual evidence generation with visual token prediction over the input-video visual vocabulary. (c) At inference with the supervised model, each decoder hidden state is projected into a latent visual state and fed back as the input for the next decoding step, enabling autoregressive reasoning over latent visual evidence without additional visual observations.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: Effect of the inference-time latent-step budget on five video benchmarks. Enlarged markers denote the best results.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.title: VideoLVR: Latent Visual Reasoning over Grounded Video Evidence
papers.title_zh: VideoLVR：基于定位视频证据的潜在视觉推理

papers.abstract: Failure diagnosers for robot manipulation are increasingly vision--language models (VLMs), trained and evaluated on single-arm failures produced by perturbing a successful demonstration. Bimanual tool use adds failures of other kinds: a tool that slips out of its socket while still held, two correct gestures made at different times, and attempts that fail for two reasons at once. On a simulated bimanual tool-use task whose failure causes are read from the recorded trace, we measure what each sensing channel lets a diagnoser tell. The tool's slip is read on the tool hand; which hand was late is read on both arms, while a sensor on one hand reads its own hand's delay and at most part of the other's; and whether a late attempt was also pushed too weakly is not identifiable from passive sensing when the tool hand is late. Within two attempts, a repair policy that escalates when the cause is not identifiable repairs as many failures as one told the true cause. A VLM's internal state carries the late hand almost perfectly, along a direction no closer to the one its answer reads than a random one; whether the answer reports it depends on the wording of the question.

analysis.key_results: 工具滑脱可通过工具手传感读出；哪只手滞后需双臂传感；单手仅能读出自身延迟及部分对方延迟；当工具手滞后时，被动传感无法辨识是否同时推压过弱；VLM内部状态几乎完整携带滞后手信息，但该方向与回答所依赖的方向相差甚远，且回答是否报告取决于问题措辞。
analysis.main_contribution: 系统评估了视觉语言模型在双臂工具操作故障诊断中的能力，量化了不同传感器配置下故障原因的辨识性，并揭示了VLM内部状态与回答一致性之间的差距。
analysis.method: 在模拟双臂工具使用任务中设置多种故障类型，通过扰动成功演示生成故障样本，利用记录轨迹读取真实故障原因，测量各传感通道的诊断信息量，并对VLM的内部表征与输出行为进行分析。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文研究基于视觉语言模型的故障诊断器在双臂工具使用任务中的表现，分析不同传感通道对故障原因的辨识能力，并探讨VLM内部状态与最终回答之间的关系。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该研究直接针对视觉语言模型（VLM）在机器人操作故障诊断中的应用，属于VLA相关的评估与机理分析，虽然未涉及世界模型或动作预测，但对VLA在双臂操作中的可靠性和可解释性具有方法学价值。

papers.abstract: Multi-robot control requires integrating distributed camera views while predicting separate action sequences. Most vision-language-action and world-action models target one robot. Combining multiple views alone does not establish spatial correspondence between them. World Dreamer v5-lite is a multi-robot world-action model built around a shared world state for robot-specific action prediction. Calibrated features from a pretrained video encoder populate this state in workspace coordinates; its spatial size remains fixed as views are added. A vision-language model provides scene context and one query per robot. The queries read the shared state and exchange pose-aware information, while their action streams remain separate. Masked-view cooperative training withholds selected camera views from both visual branches while retaining all action targets. This encourages the use of observations shared by other robots. Pretraining uses more than 10,000 hours of trajectories from 20 simulated robot types, RoboFactory, and real robots. On RoboFactory, World Dreamer v5-lite achieves 74.0% mean success, 23.7 percentage points above the strongest evaluated baseline. Across four real-robot tasks, it reaches 78.8% mean success, a margin of 13.8 points. It also reaches 58.08% overall on RoboCasa365.

analysis.key_results: 在 RoboFactory 上平均成功率达 74.0%，比最强基线高 23.7 个百分点；在四个真实机器人任务上平均成功率达 78.8%，高出 13.8 个百分点；在 RoboCasa365 上总体得分为 58.08%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了 World Dreamer v5-lite，一个面向多机器人控制的世界-动作模型，利用共享世界状态和姿势感知查询来实现机器人特定的动作预测。
analysis.method: 使用预训练视频编码器在共享工作空间坐标中构建固定大小的世界状态，由视觉语言模型提供场景上下文并为每个机器人生成查询；采用掩码视图协作训练，随机隐藏部分相机视图以鼓励利用其他机器人共享的观测。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种多机器人世界-动作模型，通过共享世界状态实现机器人间空间对应和协作，在大规模多机器人数据上取得显著提升。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接研究世界-动作模型（WAM），面向多机器人设置，属于本站高度关注的主题；它扩展了单一机器人的 VLA/WAM 到多机器人协作场景，引入共享世界状态和跨机器人信息交互，对机器人世界建模和策略学习具有直接价值。

The video strip depicts a temporal window: observed video latents are encoded and combined with camera geometry to build the shared world state ϕ \boldsymbol{\phi} ; future latents supply training supervision only. The Action Decoder uses the VLM outputs, ϕ \boldsymbol{\phi} , proprioception, and multi-robot noisy actions to predict a flow velocity for each robot.

Each token is fused with its geometric embedding ( + + ) and written to the XY, XZ, and YZ planes. The right-hand panels schematically show how ϕ \boldsymbol{\phi} is updated over successive observed frames.

papers.abstract: Integrated sensing and communication allows wireless networks to recognize human activity from the channel estimates that the receiver computes anyway. The inference, however, runs on the general-purpose processors of the base station, access point or handset, which are the first components a device switches off to save energy. Always-on sensing therefore requires a classifier that is small enough to remain powered while the rest of the system sleeps. We investigate whether Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) can provide such a classifier. To this end, we generate SNN accelerators for micro-Doppler activity recognition on the public DISC dataset (IEEE 802.11ay at 60 GHz) with the open-source Spiker+ framework, and implement them together with a spike encoder on a ZCU208 RFSoC, so that the complete chain from micro-Doppler frame to activity label runs in programmable logic. A fully connected SNN with 132 neurons achieves 94.7 % accuracy (90.7 % macro-F1) on unseen subjects and performs an inference in 206 microseconds. Compared to conventional networks of the same topology on the same device, it requires an eighth of the logic and 3.4X less dynamic energy per decision than a network fed the same binary spikes, at comparable accuracy, and 7.6X less than a network fed the 16-bit spectrogram, at 1.2 points lower accuracy. Quantization-aware training reduces its weights to 3 bits within half a percentage point of the 6-bit network at the same encoder threshold

analysis.key_results: 全连接SNN（132个神经元）在未见受试者上达到94.7%准确率（90.7%宏F1），单次推理耗时206微秒；相比同拓扑传统网络，逻辑资源减少至八分之一，动态能耗降低3.4倍（相比输入二进制脉冲）和7.6倍（相比输入16位频谱图），准确率仅降低1.2个百分点；量化感知训练将权重量化至3比特，准确率较6比特网络下降不超过0.5个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出并实现了一种脉冲神经网络加速器，使微多普勒活动识别可在ZCU208 RFSoC的可编程逻辑上运行，实现低功耗、小面积和快速推理。
analysis.method: 使用Spiker+框架生成SNN加速器，结合脉冲编码器在可编程逻辑上实现从微多普勒帧到活动标签的完整处理链，并采用量化感知训练降低权重量化比特。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文设计并测量了一种基于脉冲神经网络的低功耗活动识别分类器，用于毫米波感知通信一体化系统中的微多普勒活动识别。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文聚焦于无线感知网络中的高效推理，提出了一种脉冲神经网络加速器，并应用于微多普勒活动识别。该工作与视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型、世界-动作模型（WAM）或机器人操作无直接关系，但其在模型量化与高效推理方面的技术可为机器人领域中的高效模型部署提供参考。
